description: Message in a bottle: real drift bottles people tossed from Florida's shores with earlier versions of our free apps, moved every 3 hours on the real ocean currents and wind until they wash up on a real beach. Answers 'any bottles washed up near me?': the beaches near a spot where bottles washed up, how many, miles away, the longest drift and days at sea, how many times found, and how many are adrift right now. Never the note, a name or an exact spot. Gives one sentence to say out loud.
